slides.title: Army chief blames Eritrea for new attacks
slides.body: Claims made Saturday · not independently verified

slides.title: A "fourth round" of attacks
slides.body: Field Marshal Birhanu Jula said TPLF forces attacked military positions in Amhara and Afar, and that federal forces repelled them.

slides.title: Accusations against neighbours
slides.body: He said Eritrea led the offensive and Egypt supplied weapons and logistics. Neither has responded; both have rejected such claims before.
